topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Walking into the school, memories flood back as I recognize the familiar hallways and posters. There he is, standing by the door, the same teacher I had so many years ago. It’s an unexpected surprise to see him, and I can’t help but smile widely, remembering the countless lessons and jokes that made my days brighter. As I watch my child approach him, the connection feels more than just coincidental. It’s a loop of time, a thread woven between my past and my child’s present. I feel a warm rush thinking about all the positive influences he’ll bring to my little one’s life, just as he did for me.
